dict.string: Control playback and read track information from Music or Spotify only when you choose Connect.
MacNotch captures your display only when you request a screenshot or start a screen recording. Screenshots and recordings are saved locally on this Mac.
MacNotch adds your microphone to a screen recording only when you enable Include microphone and start recording.
MacNotch transcribes a recording only when you request it. Transcription requires on-device speech recognition and is not uploaded.
MacNotch reads your upcoming events only when you choose Load Events in the Calendar tab. Event details stay on this Mac.
MacNotch loads upcoming reminders only when you choose Load Reminders. It marks a reminder complete only when you press its Complete button.
